name: Blur wallpaper with adjustable intensity.
description:
Your wallpaper. Two views. Just the right blur.

Soften your desktop and bring your wallpaper into the Activities overview, each with its own blur intensity. Keep Overview sharper than your desktop, or choose any balance from 0 to 300 px.

Supports light and dark wallpapers. Uses cached images instead of a live GPU blur effect. Restores your original wallpaper when disabled.

Requires ImageMagick (the magick command).
